About.heroTitle: Farming with heart, rooted in community.
About.heroDesc: Since 2015, Manikstu Agro has transformed goat farming through sustainable practices, community partnerships and cutting-edge technology, in the heart of Kalahandi, Odisha.
About.microStatement: Nurturing goats, farmers and futures, together
About.fallbackVision1: To become India's most trusted goat farming ecosystem, empowering farmers with sustainable practices and innovative solutions.
About.fallbackVision2: By 2030, we aim to empower 50,000+ farmers and transform rural livelihoods across India.
About.visionP1: To become India's most trusted goat farming ecosystem, empowering farmers with sustainable practices and innovative solutions.
About.visionP2: By 2030, we aim to empower 50,000+ farmers and transform rural livelihoods across India.
About.visionP3: A future where every farmer has access to quality livestock, healthcare, training and fair markets.
About.fallbackMission1: To revolutionize goat farming through integrated solutions that combine technology, training, healthcare and market access.
About.fallbackMission2: We believe in farming with heart, nurturing goats, farmers and futures together.
About.missionP1: To revolutionize goat farming through integrated solutions that combine technology, training, healthcare and market access.
About.missionP2: We believe in farming with heart, nurturing goats, farmers and futures together.
About.missionP3: Building scalable, community-driven models that create dignified rural livelihoods across India.
About.timeline1Desc: Started with a vision to transform goat farming in Kalahandi, Odisha.
About.timeline2015Desc: Started with a vision to transform goat farming in Kalahandi, Odisha.
About.timeline2Desc: Launched comprehensive goat care training for local farmers.
About.timeline2018Desc: Launched comprehensive goat care training for local farmers.
About.timeline3Desc: Started Samarth goat bank project to provide livestock to landless farmers.
About.timeline2020Desc: Started Samarth goat bank project to provide livestock to landless farmers.
About.timeline4Desc: Launched our digital presence for wider outreach and product sales.
About.timeline2022Desc: Featured in PM Modi's Mann Ki Baat for our innovative goat bank model.
About.timeline2024Desc: Expanded operations to 10+ states, impacting over 25,000 farmers.
About.value1Desc: We believe in farming with heart, putting communities at the center of everything we do.
About.value2Desc: We provide only the highest quality genetics and continuously innovate our solutions.
About.value3Desc: Our practices protect the environment while ensuring no farmer is left behind.
About.storyP1: Founded in 2015 in the tribal heartland of Kalahandi, Odisha, Manikstu Agro began as a small initiative to support marginal farmers through goat farming. What started with a handful of farmers has now grown into a movement that is transforming lives across states.
About.storyP2: We believe in the power of collective growth and sustainable livelihoods. Our journey is rooted in trust, local knowledge, and a deep understanding of rural India.
About.valuePeopleFirstDesc: We place smallholder farmers, tribal women, and rural families at the heart of our mission, ensuring equitable income, fair livestock trade, and holistic community dignity.
About.valueIntegrityDesc: We uphold uncompromising honesty, ethical breed care, fair market price guarantees, and deep accountability to every farmer partner, SHG group, and institution.
About.valueSustainabilityDesc: We promote eco-friendly goat rearing, indigenous forage cultivation, and climate-resilient farming models that preserve natural biodiversity for decades to come.
About.valueInnovationDesc: We harness mobile vet tele-diagnostics, genetic selective breeding, and digital farm management to build scalable, modern solutions for rural India's challenges.
About.award2024Desc: Featured in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "Mann ki Baat", 2024
About.award2023AgriDesc: Agri Startup of the Year 2023 by OCF
About.award2022CarnivalDesc: Top 5 in Odisha StartUp Carnival in 2022 organized by AIC – Nalanda
About.award2021Desc: One of the top 40 Startups in India in "40 under 40"

Services.heroDesc: From veterinary care to farm management, we support every stage of the goat-farming journey.
Services.microStatement: Practical support at every stage of the farmer's journey
Services.servicesDesc: Integrated support for every stage of the goat-farming journey, veterinary care, farm management, insurance and technology under one roof.
Services.goatCareDesc: Manikstu Agro is dedicated to the health and productivity of goats through our team of skilled Pashu Seva Adhikaris (PSAs), who provide essential veterinary and breeding services. We are committed to supporting farmers with reliable, expert care across all stages of goat health management.
Services.farmManagementDesc: Technology is essential for scaling operations and streamlining daily tasks in goat farming. Recognizing this need, Manikstu has developed a comprehensive suite of ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modules tailored specifically for the diverse stakeholders in the goat farming ecosystem. These modules aim to enhance efficiency, improve management practices, and ultimately boost profitability for farmers and organizations alike. Here's a closer look at the various ERP modules offered by Manikstu:
Services.goatFarmingDesc: Goat farming can be a highly profitable and sustainable business when farmers follow proper scientific methods and proven solutions. Manikstu is committed to supporting farmers by offering a range of comprehensive goat farming solutions tailored to their needs:
Services.goatInsuranceDesc: Goat farming can be an extremely lucrative venture, yet many farmers remain hesitant to engage in it due to the inherent risks associated with the industry. Our insurance support helps farmers safeguard their livestock and invest with confidence.
Services.vaccinationDesc: Goats require four critical vaccines each year to protect against viral and genetic diseases. Our PSAs provide comprehensive vaccination services within their assigned areas to keep goats healthy. Farmers outside our service area can still access our support through vaccine delivery and guided video-call instructions for safe administration.
Services.treatmentDesc: Timely diagnosis and treatment of common and complex goat ailments by our trained Pashu Seva Adhikaris, with on-call and on-field support to minimise losses and keep herds productive.
Services.pregnancyCareDesc: End-to-end care for pregnant does, nutrition guidance, health monitoring and safe-delivery preparation to protect both mother and kids through every stage of gestation.
Services.goatKidBirthDesc: Expert assistance during kidding, from safe delivery to newborn care, ensuring healthy kids and reduced mortality in the critical first days of life.
Services.naturalBreedingDesc: Selective natural breeding programmes using quality bucks to improve herd genetics, growth rates and overall productivity for farmers.
Services.artificialInseminationDesc: Access to superior genetics through AI services, enabling farmers to raise healthier, higher-yielding goats without the cost of maintaining breeding bucks.
Services.goatShedDesc: Guidance and support to build well-ventilated, hygienic and cost-effective goat sheds designed for healthy, productive herds.
Services.breederSelectionDesc: Expert help choosing the right breeds and quality breeding stock suited to your climate, goals and market.
Services.livestockProcurementDesc: Sourcing of healthy, verified goats through our trusted network, so farmers start with strong, disease-free animals.
Services.fodderManagementDesc: Planning and support for year-round green and dry fodder, from cultivation to storage, for balanced, low-cost nutrition.
Services.feedSupplementsDesc: Quality feed, minerals and supplements to boost growth, immunity and productivity across every life stage.
Services.vetEquipmentDesc: Access to essential veterinary tools and equipment for safe, timely on-farm care.
Services.manpowerSolutionsDesc: Trained manpower and workforce support to help farms run smoothly and scale with confidence.
Services.goatFarmAppDesc: A complete digital toolkit for farmers to manage herds, track health, breeding and feed, and plan day-to-day farm operations from a single dashboard.
Services.livelihoodAppDesc: Purpose-built for development organisations to plan, monitor and report on livestock-based livelihood programmes at scale.
Services.psaAppDesc: Equips Pashu Seva Adhikaris to schedule visits, record treatments and vaccinations, and coordinate field service across their assigned areas.
Services.goatCareAppDesc: Puts expert goat-care guidance, reminders and remote support in farmers' hands, vaccination schedules, symptom help and video consultations.
Services.insuranceDesc1: Goat farming can be an extremely lucrative venture, yet many farmers remain hesitant to engage in it due to the inherent risks associated with the industry. One of the primary concerns is that goats are particularly susceptible to communicable diseases, which can significantly impact their health and the overall viability of a farm. Although proper vaccination protocols and a well-balanced diet can reduce mortality rates by as much as 60%, the average mortality still hovers around 8% to 12%. This means that even with preventative measures in place, farmers face a considerable risk of losing a significant portion of their livestock.
Services.insuranceDesc2: Moreover, in the event of a disease outbreak, it can be incredibly challenging to detect infected goats and effectively isolate them from the rest of the herd. This difficulty complicates the management of livestock and can lead to further losses if the disease spreads.
Services.insuranceDesc3: To address these pressing challenges, Manikstu has established collaborations with various insurance companies to provide Livestock Insurance specifically for farmers' goats. This insurance product is designed to help mitigate the financial risks associated with livestock mortality, allowing farmers to recover from potential losses more effectively. By offering this support, Manikstu aims to enhance the stability and sustainability of goat farming as a viable business option.
Services.insuranceDesc4: Functioning as a vital link between farmers and insurance providers, Manikstu offers comprehensive support throughout the entire process. This includes services such as tagging the goats, facilitating the insurance coverage, and streamlining the claims settlement process. By managing these aspects, Manikstu helps to alleviate some of the burdens that farmers face when dealing with livestock insurance.
Services.insuranceDesc5: Farmers interested in this service can benefit from competitive premium rates offered by Manikstu, making it more accessible for them to protect their investments. Additionally, the company provides convenient features such as doorstep tagging and high-priority claim settlements, ensuring that farmers receive timely support when they need it most. Ultimately, Manikstu's initiatives aim to foster a more resilient and profitable goat farming industry, encouraging more farmers to take advantage of this opportunity without the looming fear of substantial losses.

Training.heroTitle: Développer les capacités. Transformer les communautés.
Training.heroDesc: Nous dotons les agriculteurs, les groupes agricoles et la jeunesse rurale des connaissances, des compétences et de la confiance nécessaires pour construire des moyens de subsistance résilients et durables dans l'économie de l'élevage.
Training.microStatement: Le savoir est la première ressource d'une ferme prospère
Training.programsTitle: Programmes qui renforcent la confiance et les capacités
Training.programsDesc: Du terrain à la fédération, nos programmes de formation rencontrent les agriculteurs là où ils sont et évoluent avec eux.
Training.awarenessTitle: Atteindre chaque village et chaque foyer
Training.awarenessDesc: La sensibilisation est le fondement de l'adoption. Nous apportons les connaissances directement aux communautés via des campagnes villageoises, des camps de santé et les médias locaux.
Training.impactTitle: Des connaissances qui se propagent dans tout le pays
Training.ctaTitle: Associez-vous à nous pour former la prochaine génération d'agriculteurs
Training.ctaDesc: Que vous soyez une communauté, une institution ou une organisation, nous serions ravis d'apporter formation et sensibilisation dans votre village.
Training.program1Desc: Formation pratique dans nos fermes modèles couvrant l'élevage caprin, l'alimentation, les soins de santé et la gestion agricole.
Training.program2Title: Renforcement des capacités des FPO et SHG
Training.program2Desc: Renforcement des Organisations de Producteurs Agricoles et des Groupes d'Autosupport en gouvernance, comptabilité et compétences entrepreneuriales.
Training.program3Desc: Camps vétérinaires communautaires et campagnes de sensibilisation sur la vaccination, la déparasitage et la prévention des maladies.
Training.program4Desc: Culture de fourrages, gestion de l'eau et pratiques organiques pour la durabilité agricole à long terme.
Training.program5Title: Autonomisation des femmes et des jeunes
Training.program5Desc: Développement des compétences et parcours entrepreneuriaux pour les femmes rurales et les jeunes.
Training.program6Title: Formation Goat Bank et moyens de subsistance
Training.program6Desc: Formation sur notre modèle Goat Bank, de la sélection des animaux au remboursement et à la gestion du troupeau.
Training.initiative1Desc: Campagnes au niveau villageois sur la nutrition, l'hygiène et les bonnes pratiques d'élevage.
Training.initiative2Desc: Camps périodiques pour la vaccination, le déparasitage et les contrôles de santé généraux.
Training.initiative3Title: Parcelles de démonstration et journées de terrain
Training.initiative3Desc: Démonstrations en direct de fourrages, techniques d'alimentation et méthodes d'agriculture durable.
Training.initiative4Desc: Conseils ponctuels et localisés sur la météo, les prix du marché et la santé animale via la radio et le téléphone.

Collaborate.heroDesc: Nous construisons un écosystème florissant avec les groupes agricoles, les entreprises, les organisations de développement et l'État pour développer des moyens de subsistance durables basés sur l'élevage à travers l'Inde.

Collaborate.partnerTitle: Une coalition pour un impact durable
Collaborate.partnerDesc: Des organisations de base aux institutions mondiales, chaque partenaire joue un rôle essentiel dans le développement des moyens de subsistance ruraux.
Collaborate.howTitle: De la première conversation à l'impact partagé
Collaborate.howDesc: Un processus simple et transparent qui maintient les communautés et les partenaires alignés à chaque étape.
Collaborate.impactTitle: Une collaboration qui s'étend à travers tout le pays
Collaborate.ctaTitle: Associez-vous à nous pour bâtir l'avenir des moyens de subsistance ruraux
Collaborate.ctaDesc: Parlez-nous de votre organisation et du changement que vous souhaitez créer. Nous construirons une collaboration à impact durable.
Collaborate.partner1Desc: Renforcer les organisations de producteurs agricoles grâce à la formation, la gouvernance et les liens commerciaux.
Collaborate.partner2Desc: Co-créer des programmes RSE qui génèrent un impact rural mesurable.
Collaborate.partner3Desc: Combiner la portée de terrain avec l'expertise technique pour des solutions évolutives.
Collaborate.partner4Desc: Collaborer sur des programmes, des projets pilotes et des recherches qui transforment les moyens de subsistance ruraux.
Collaborate.partner5Desc: Sapprovisionner en produits caprins éthiquement produits et créer un accès équitable au marché.
Collaborate.partner6Desc: Permettre le crédit, l'assurance et la littératie financière pour les agriculteurs ruraux.

Collaborate.step2Desc: Nous co-créons des programmes adaptés au contexte local, aux ressources et aux objectifs.
Collaborate.step3Desc: Nous mettons en œuvre sur le terrain avec des équipes formées et des leaders communautaires.
Collaborate.step4Desc: Nous suivons les résultats, partageons les données et améliorons continuellement notre approche.

Ajah.heroTitle: Entrepreneuriat livestock intégré dirigé par des femmes
Ajah.heroDesc: Autonomiser les femmes agricultrices grâce à un modèle intégré d'élevage caprin et avicole, combinant gestion scientifique des élevages, infrastructures améliorées, soins vétérinaires, formation, assurance et soutien commercial.
Ajah.microStatement: Quand les femmes dirigent, les communautés entières prospèrent
Ajah.modelDesc: Le projet AJAH tisse ensemble l'ensemble de la chaîne de moyens de subsistance, de la génétique animale à l'accès au marché, pour que les femmes agricultrices puissent construire des revenus durables et dignes.
Ajah.ctaTitle: Soutenez les moyens de subsistance dirigés par des femmes avec le projet AJAH
Ajah.ctaDesc: Partenez, financez ou testez AJAH dans votre région. Ensemble, nous pouvons développer dignité et revenus pour des milliers de femmes agricultrices.
Ajah.pillar1Desc: Pratiques améliorées de reproduction, d'alimentation et d'élevage pour une productivité accrue.
Ajah.pillar2Desc: Meilleur logement, stockage de fourrages et systèmes d'eau pour des troupeaux en meilleure santé.
Ajah.pillar3Desc: Vaccination régulière, prévention des maladies et accès à la vétérinaire.
Ajah.pillar4Desc: Développement pratique des compétences pour les femmes agricultrices en gestion d'élevage.
Ajah.pillar5Desc: Couverture de risque protégeant les familles contre les pertes animales imprévues.
Ajah.pillar6Desc: Mise en relation avec des marchés équitables et fiables pour les produits caprins et avicoles.
